# .NET project scaffold fixtures

UTF-8 LF output from [dotnet-tools templates](https://github.com/artur-rios/dotnet-tools/tree/7cd0a4867dbbd0301ddb5e6a207fbb0b29c56998/templates). UC56 NuGet mode clears template placeholders and fixed package metadata values while retaining all elements. Original attribution is retained in the source repository license.
